```yaml
name: Publish to npm

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 'lts/*'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: .
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: npm ci
          cache-key-prefix: npm-install

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Publish to npm
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: npm publish
        continue-on-error: false
```
